name: Doppelgangers
description: End-game hidden threat. Ships lost to capture sometimes come back as sleepers: recaptured hulls may be turned, and derelicts of an empire's own designs are planted near its territory for its own explorers to claim. At enough live sleepers, The Mirror rises and every sleeper turns on its old fleet at once.
